title: Windsurf Editor
description: Windsurf is a next-generation code editor built on VS Code with advanced AI capabilities. Features intelligent code completion, multi-file editing, and seamless AI integration. Designed for modern development workflows with enhanced productivity tools.

title: Trae AI
description: Trae AI is an AI-powered IDE that combines coding assistance with project management. Features intelligent code generation, debugging support, and team collaboration tools. Built for modern software development with focus on AI-enhanced productivity.

title: Bolt.new
description: Bolt.new is an AI-powered web development platform that generates full-stack applications from text prompts. Features instant deployment, real-time collaboration, and modern tech stack integration. Perfect for rapid prototyping and full-stack development.

title: v0.dev
description: v0.dev is Vercel's AI-powered UI component builder. Generates production-ready React components from text descriptions. Features instant preview, responsive design, and seamless integration with modern web frameworks.

title: Tempo
description: Tempo is an AI-powered code review and documentation platform. Features automated code analysis, intelligent suggestions, and team collaboration tools. Helps maintain code quality and accelerate development workflows.

title: Mintlify
description: Mintlify is an AI-powered documentation platform that generates beautiful documentation from code. Features automatic API documentation, interactive examples, and seamless deployment. Perfect for developer-focused product documentation.

title: Linear
description: Linear is a modern issue tracking and project management tool designed for software teams. Features streamlined workflows, powerful search, and seamless integration with development tools. Known for its speed and developer-friendly interface.

title: Arc Browser
description: Arc is a modern web browser designed for productivity and creativity. Features AI-powered features, customizable interface, built-in note-taking, and seamless integration with modern web workflows. Popular among designers and developers.

title: Raycast
description: Raycast is a blazingly fast, extensible launcher for macOS. Features AI-powered commands, extensive integrations, and custom workflows. Perfect for developers looking to boost productivity with keyboard-driven workflows.

title: Warp Terminal
description: Warp is a modern terminal built for developers. Features AI-powered command suggestions, collaborative features, and beautiful interface. Supports all major shells and provides enhanced productivity for command-line workflows.

title: Figma AI
description: Figma AI brings AI-powered features to the Figma design platform. Features include AI-generated designs, component suggestions, layout generation, and design variations. Helps designers work faster and more efficiently.

title: Confluence
description: Confluence is a collaboration tool for teams to create, share, and collaborate on content. Features include wikis, documentation, knowledge bases, and team spaces. Essential for technical documentation and team knowledge sharing.

title: Jira
description: Jira is a project management tool developed by Atlassian. Features include issue tracking, agile project management, and extensive customization. Widely used for software development and IT operations.

title: Asana
description: Asana is a work management platform designed to help teams organize, track, and manage their work. Features include task management, project tracking, timelines, and reporting capabilities.

title: Trello
description: Trello is a web-based Kanban-style list-making application. Features include boards, lists, and cards for project management. Simple and intuitive interface for task tracking and team collaboration.

title: Microsoft Office 365
description: Microsoft Office 365 is a subscription-based office suite including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams. Features cloud storage, real-time collaboration, and advanced productivity tools.

title: Google Workspace
description: Google Workspace is a collection of productivity apps including Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, and Meet. Features real-time collaboration, cloud storage, and seamless integration across devices.

title: Microsoft Teams
description: Microsoft Teams is a collaboration platform that combines chat, video meetings, file storage, and app integration. Features include channels, video calls, and integration with Microsoft 365 applications.

title: Zoom
description: Zoom is a video conferencing platform. Features include HD video, audio, screen sharing, and virtual backgrounds. Essential for remote work, online meetings, and virtual events.

title: Discord
description: Discord is a voice, video, and text communication service. Features include voice channels, screen sharing, and community servers. Popular for gaming communities, developer communities, and team communication.

title: Slack
description: Slack is a messaging app for business that connects people to the information they need. Features include channels, direct messaging, file sharing, and integrations with thousands of apps. Essential for team communication.

title: Notion
description: Notion is an all-in-one workspace for notes, docs, and projects. Features include databases, wikis, calendars, and kanban boards. Highly customizable and used for personal and team productivity.

title: Sketch
description: Sketch is a digital design toolkit for macOS. Features vector editing, prototyping, and design systems. Popular among UI/UX designers for creating interfaces and interactive prototypes.

title: Adobe XD
description: Adobe XD is a powerful UI/UX design and prototyping tool. Features include design, prototyping, and collaboration capabilities. Integrates seamlessly with other Adobe Creative Cloud applications.

title: Figma
description: Figma is a vector graphics editor and prototyping tool. Features collaborative design, real-time editing, and comprehensive design systems. Used by teams for UI/UX design, prototyping, and design collaboration.

title: GitHub Desktop
description: GitHub Desktop is a free, open-source application that lets you manage Git repositories from your desktop. Features include repository cloning, branching, committing, and pull requests. Simplifies Git workflows for beginners and experts.

title: Git
description: Git is a free and open-source distributed version control system. Features include branching, merging, and collaboration capabilities. Essential for modern software development and team collaboration.

title: Docker Desktop
description: Docker Desktop is an easy-to-install application for building, sharing, and running containerized applications. Features include container management, Kubernetes integration, and development environments.

title: Postman
description: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. Features include API testing, documentation, monitoring, and collaboration tools. Essential for API development, testing, and documentation workflows.

title: Xcode
description: Xcode is Apple's integrated development environment for macOS. Features include code editing, debugging, interface builder, and simulator. Used for developing iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS applications with Swift and Objective-C.

title: Android Studio
description: Android Studio is the official IDE for Android development. Features include code editing, debugging, performance tooling, and emulator. Supports Kotlin and Java development with comprehensive Android SDK integration.

title: PyCharm
description: PyCharm is a dedicated Python IDE with intelligent coding assistance, debugging, testing, and web development support. Features include code analysis, refactoring, and integration with popular Python frameworks and libraries.

title: WebStorm
description: WebStorm is a powerful IDE for modern JavaScript development. Features intelligent coding assistance, advanced debugging, and seamless integration with popular web frameworks. Includes built-in tools for Node.js, React, Angular, and more.

title: Cursor
description: Cursor is an AI-powered code editor built on VS Code. Features AI chat, code completion, refactoring, and natural language code editing. Combines the familiarity of VS Code with advanced AI capabilities for faster development.

title: Visual Studio Code
description: Visual Studio Code is a free, open-source code editor developed by Microsoft. Features include IntelliSense, debugging, Git integration, and extensive extension marketplace. Supports hundreds of languages and frameworks.
